paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "QAdapter," illustrates the GPU memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) for different fine-tuning methods applied to a language model. The horizontal axis contains category labels arranged from left to right: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, Adapter, QAdapter, and Ours. The vertical axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 80 GB, with gridlines at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. There are six bars in total. The first five bars are colored orange, while the last bar, labeled "Ours" (displayed in bold text), is colored dark green, visually distinguishing it from the other methods. The tallest bar is "Full FT" at approximately 73 GB, followed by "MTL-FT" at approximately 43 GB, "TAG" at approximately 19 GB, "Adapter" at approximately 17 GB, "QAdapter" at approximately 9 GB (the shortest bar), and "Ours" at approximately 19 GB. The bars appear to be arranged in a specific order that roughly follows a descending pattern for the first five bars, with the "Ours" bar placed last. The "Ours" label is rendered in bold, providing visual emphasis on that particular bar.
